description: Fallout 76-inspired nuke silo system for Atomic Fizz Caps. Players collect nuclear keycards by completing quests and finding them in the world. Once a player has 3 keycards AND has decrypted the launch code (an 8-character alphanumeric code distributed in pieces across the map), they can launch a tactical nuke at any GPS-defined zone. Nuke zones persist for 3 hours and grant access to unique mutated loot, crafting materials, and boss encounters unavailable elsewhere.

mechanic_overview.keycard_collection: Nuclear keycards are rare drops from high-level enemies, quest rewards, and geo-fence locations. Each keycard is single-use per launch.
mechanic_overview.launch_codes: An 8-character launch code is generated weekly. Fragments (2-char pieces) are distributed across 4 locations. Players must collect all 4 fragments and combine them.
mechanic_overview.launch_sequence: Requires: 3 keycards + complete 8-char code + reaching a silo terminal in-game (GPS location). Launch targets a GPS zone of player's choice.
mechanic_overview.nuke_zone_effects: Active nuke zone (3 hours): unique boss spawns, mutated loot, high radiation, accessible only to players with RadAway and adequate radiation resistance.
mechanic_overview.keycard_note: Keycards do not stack — each is a unique item. Spending 3 launches a nuke. Keycards can be traded between players.

silos.name: Vault-Tec Silo Alpha
silos.description: A pre-war missile installation concealed beneath what appeared to be a water treatment facility east of Las Vegas. The Poseidon Energy logos on the outside are the tell — no utility company needed that much reinforced concrete.
silos.terminal_lore: FACILITY DESIGNATION: ALPHA-SEVEN. STATUS: DORMANT. AUTHORIZATION SEQUENCE: AWAITING. NOTE: The automated launch protocols are still active. The system does not know the war is over. Please do not tell it.

silos.name: Iron Curtain Installation Bravo
silos.description: Military installation carved into the Nevada mountains. Exterior detonations have collapsed the main entrance but the launch bay is intact — accessible only through a flooded service tunnel.
silos.terminal_lore: FACILITY DESIGNATION: BRAVO-TWELVE. AUTHORIZATION STATUS: THREE-KEY PROTOCOL. Note from former overseer: If you're reading this, the war happened. Launch only in response to active threat. Define 'active threat' carefully. I didn't.

silos.name: Enclave Installation Charlie
silos.description: A thin, reinforced launch shaft sunk into Mojave bedrock. Enclave tech, post-war construction — someone built this after the bombs fell using salvaged pre-war components. The targeting system uses satellite link that somehow still functions.
silos.terminal_lore: ENCLAVE CONTINUITY INSTALLATION CHARLIE. PRIORITY: AMERICA FIRST, LAST, ALWAYS. Launch authorization requires three senior Enclave officers. There are no senior Enclave officers remaining. System has defaulted to civilian authorization protocol. God help us all.

nuke_zones.name: The Irradiated Strip
nuke_zones.description: The casino district of Las Vegas, irradiated. Even the ghouls put on their best suits to loot this zone.

unique_bosses.name: The Irradiated Casino Baron
unique_bosses.description: A pre-war casino magnate turned Glowing One who still believes he runs the house. He does. The house is on fire.

mutated_crafting_materials.name: Violet Flux
mutated_crafting_materials.description: Irradiated casino carpet fibers fused by nuclear heat. Crafting: radiation weapons mod, glowing armor paint.

mutated_crafting_materials.name: Irradiated Casino Glass
mutated_crafting_materials.description: Fused glass from casino windows, still faintly warm. Crafting: glowing bottles, irradiated lens mod.

nuke_zones.name: The Scorched Flats
nuke_zones.description: Open desert turned nuclear hellscape. Creatures here have absorbed enough radiation to glow, mutate, and get angry about it.

unique_bosses.name: Scorched Radscorpion Queen
unique_bosses.description: An Emperor Radscorpion variant that absorbed the full blast. Now she's radioactive, territorial, and the size of a small building.

mutated_crafting_materials.name: Cobalt Flux
mutated_crafting_materials.description: Irradiated desert sand compacted by blast pressure into blue-glowing granules. Crafting: energy weapon power cells, radiation-enhanced ammunition.

mutated_crafting_materials.name: Scorched Blast Blossom
mutated_crafting_materials.description: Desert wildflowers that only bloom in nuclear aftermath. Crafting: nuclear stimpaks (heal + rads), mutation catalysts.

nuke_zones.name: The Vault Cluster
nuke_zones.description: The cluster of Vault-Tec installations north of the city. Nuking this zone activates ancient automated defense systems and shakes loose pre-war tech that's been sealed since 2077.

unique_bosses.name: Irradiated Overseer Mk. III
unique_bosses.description: A prototype Vault-Tec Overseer robot that was sealed in the complex and activated by the blast. It has opinions about your vault assignment.

mutated_crafting_materials.name: Yellowcake Flux
mutated_crafting_materials.description: Uranium compound extracted from Vault-Tec's experimental storage. Crafting: nuclear keycards (partial), experimental armor plating.

mutated_crafting_materials.name: Irradiated Polymer
mutated_crafting_materials.description: Vault-Tec composite material irradiated to structural enhancement. Crafting: powered armor upgrades, radiation-sealed containers.

nuke_zones.name: The Burning Dam
nuke_zones.description: Hoover Dam, post-nuclear strike. The concrete is cracked, the turbines are molten, and the Colorado River has become something you really shouldn't swim in. Amazing bass fishing though.

unique_bosses.name: Molten Deathclaw Alpha
unique_bosses.description: A Deathclaw that was at the dam when it was nuked. The radiation didn't kill it. The radiation made it considerably worse.

mutated_crafting_materials.name: Crimson Flux
mutated_crafting_materials.description: Irradiated Colorado River water crystallized by the blast. Crafting: radiation water weapons, contamination grenades, nuke zone survival kits.

mutated_crafting_materials.name: Molten Concrete Shard
mutated_crafting_materials.description: Dam concrete fused at nuclear temperatures. Incredibly dense. Crafting: heavy weapon attachments, fortification materials.

keycards.name: Nuclear Keycard — Alpha
keycards.description: A three-inch metal card with embedded authentication chip. Designed to survive nuclear blast within 500m and still function. Still warm from where someone tried to hold onto it.

keycards.name: Nuclear Keycard — Bravo
keycards.description: Military authentication key, Brotherhood of Steel manufacture. Heavy encryption, biometric secondary lock that's been bypassed with what appears to be a paperclip.

keycards.name: Nuclear Keycard — Charlie
keycards.description: Enclave-manufactured authentication key. The Enclave seal is embossed on the front. The back says, in very small print: 'Property of the Enclave. If found, please destroy America responsibly.'

keycards.name: Launch Code Fragment
keycards.description: A 2-character alphanumeric fragment of the current week's nuclear launch code. Worthless alone. With the other 3 pieces, it authorizes the end of someone's day.

launch_code_system.distribution: Fragments hidden in different map zones each week. Zone locations rotate. Players must find and share intel.
launch_code_system.community_mechanic: Launch codes reward community cooperation — sharing fragments, coordinating strikes, claiming loot windows.
launch_code_system.note: Server generates code on Monday 00:00 UTC. Fragment locations are seeded from the code hash. Code expires Sunday 23:59 UTC.

reward_note: Unique flux materials and irradiated items only drop while the nuke zone is active. After 3 hours, the zone reverts to normal. Survivors keep their loot.
